pinnedExternalSourceFiles.observed: Direct-hit damage, mitigation, ward, shield/dealt, resource/reaction callbacks; timed DoT events and healing/shield emission.
13 authored affixes including hex_potency_pct, shield_strength_pct, ward_pp and accuracy/evasion.
54 class skills, 162 variants, 18 specialization skill styles; authoritative compile.
Finite reactive triggers and per-encounter cooldown state. Heal and shield triggers exist in union but are not a signature trait executor.
Server-compiled equipment and owned actor source before encounter.

scope: Unmerged Equipment 2.0 review branch cannot import sibling Combat 2.0 branch; manual source comparison and static contracts only, not executable engine parity.

fixtureProfile.label: pure-synthetic-preview-not-authoritative-combat-calibration
fixtureProfile.classPhysicalHitFractionMeaning: illustrative expected fraction of direct attacks qualifying as physical in this fixture; not a measured or authored Combat 2.0 class mechanic
fixtureProfile.roleDataUsage: Only synthetic class coverage and source ability eligibility stress, not auto-calculated balance pass/fail

requiredHostHooks.when: after final hit/crit/mitigation/shield resolution and positive actual HP damage, original direct physical ability use
requiredHostHooks.exclude: DoT ticks, class reactive/capstone secondary damage, gem echoes, companion hits, client hits, multi-hit extra rolls
requiredHostHooks.type: physical dot tag EQ2_SIG_BLEED, distinct from hex

requiredHostHooks.when: after credited incoming HP loss >=15% max HP, then add 5-second protection for NEXT eligible hit
requiredHostHooks.exclude: triggering hit, full shield absorption, environmental and DoT; count true damage as trigger only after explicit design decision
requiredHostHooks.type: damage_taken modifier -0.02 under shared mitigation family limit

requiredHostHooks.owner: server-owned actual direct heal or shield credit
requiredHostHooks.when: positive credited amount on distinct ally; one ability-use cursor with 18-second source-wide ICD
requiredHostHooks.exclude: self heal, zero effective healing, HoT ticks, GEM_MERCY/GEM_RENEWAL, capstone/companion/generated shields
requiredHostHooks.type: target 2% maxHP protective shield, cannot self-trigger

requiredHostHooks.when: mitigation after Defense / magical Ward before shield absorption, only incoming non-true direct enemy damage
requiredHostHooks.exclude: DoT ticks, true damage, environmental damage and recursive reflection

tickAndSeed.conversion: round(1000 * seconds) at the server entry boundary exactly once
tickAndSeed.rng: domain-separated server RNG in signed persisted encounter, never client-provided; preview seededRng is NOT cryptographic or reward authority
tickAndSeed.actionKey: encounterID + actorID + server-issued action sequence; ability ID by itself is NOT unique
tickAndSeed.idempotency: one credited trigger per action ID, one replay-safe proc decision and one instance-bound stack/cooldown state; rollback on unsupported status effect

crossSystemRules.triggerAndDotOwnership: status owner is exact instance owner + attacker, no cross-character replay
crossSystemRules.sharedEffectBudget: one offensive and one defensive/support signature/blueprint family slot; actual set/effect gem stacking requires explicit server policy
crossSystemRules.statusCoexistence: do not remove/consume class-authored DoTs (Hexweaver and Knife Dancer) when signature Bleed refreshes
crossSystemRules.futureWeaponEffect: damage dealt from offensive gem and attack-affix applied to original credited hit only, then bleed uses that amount once

criticalIntegrationGaps: No verified Combat 2.0 signature item ownership / Gear instance trait resolver in the inspected engine.
Current reactive-passive event union alone does not supply exact equipment instance / action-use dedup or 18s shield trigger implementation.
Existing engine tick/DoT type supports damageType physical; status-tag reapply/refresh cap and boss immunity for a new equipment DoT are not yet implemented.
Rare Blueprint and Signature source families require a single shared two-trait budget to prevent equipment+gem+set uncontrolled layering.
Existing Combat 2.0 engine source is on a DIFFERENT draft branch; this contract must be regenerated against canonical latest before implementation.
Gem 2.0 Might ATK backport and live legacy gems use separate revision schedules; never infer Power/Attack migration from older mobile file.
Do not trust this synthetic QA to establish balanced 9-class/18-spec fights. Real server-simulated enemy/dungeon/boss replays remain mandatory.
